name: Illustrative declared-design simulation
description: Explore how declared design choices interact with explicit conditions and assumptions. This uncalibrated model does not predict actual people or verify the candidate interface.

numeric_precision.threshold_basis: Rounded sampled fractions and human effort; counts remain exact. Coefficients are inputs, not estimates.

conditions.label: Available practice minutes
conditions.description: Practice time available to each simulated learner.

conditions.label: Total support capacity in minutes
conditions.description: Human support time available across the whole simulated cohort.

conditions.label: Digital access fraction
conditions.description: Fraction assumed able to use the digital delivery channel.

assumptions.label: Baseline conditional success
assumptions.description: Assumed success probability among completers before design gains and transfer penalty.

assumptions.label: Practice gain per minute
assumptions.description: Assumed additive gain per effective practice minute; this is not an estimated learning rate.

assumptions.label: Specific-feedback gain
assumptions.description: Assumed gain for specific feedback; generic feedback receives half this gain.

assumptions.label: Revision-opportunity gain
assumptions.description: Assumed additive gain when the design declares a revision opportunity.

assumptions.label: Transfer penalty
assumptions.description: Assumed reduction when applying the practiced capability in the target context.

assumptions.label: Offline recovery fraction
assumptions.description: Fraction without digital access assumed served when the design declares an offline fallback.

criteria.label: Minimum simulated learner success fraction
criteria.description: Required sampled successes divided by the full cohort, including non-completers.

criteria.label: Maximum human effort per learner
criteria.description: Maximum requested practice plus allocated support minutes per learner. Choice and data conditions also apply.

criteria.label: Minimum simulated completion fraction
criteria.description: Required sampled completions divided by the full cohort.

presets.name: Adequate conditions
presets.description: Default illustrative conditions; no successful result is guaranteed.

presets.name: Limited practice time
presets.description: Five minutes are available; other initial conditions remain at their defaults.

presets.name: Limited digital access
presets.description: Half the cohort has digital access; offline fallback may change coverage under the stated assumptions.

formulas.applicability: The model covers the declared practice, feedback, revision, access, and support relationships only. An outside_scope declaration returns indeterminate without sampling. Its rationale is an agent claim awaiting human review, not proof of eligibility or a successful outcome.
formulas.effective_practice: min(declared practice minutes, available practice minutes)
formulas.conditional_success: clip(baseline + effective practice × practice gain + feedback gain × feedback factor + revision gain × revision indicator − transfer penalty, 0, 1); feedback factor is 0 for none, 0.5 for generic, and 1 for specific
formulas.coverage: digital access + (1 − digital access) × offline recovery when fallback exists; otherwise digital access
formulas.capacity: min(1, total support capacity / (cohort size × support minutes per learner)); 1 when no support is requested
formulas.sampling: For every simulated person, draw two uniform values from a fixed-seed Python random.Random generator. Completion uses the first draw; conditional success uses the second, even when the person does not complete.
formulas.numeric_precision: Numeric inputs accept at most four decimal places. Reported metrics are rounded to four decimal places, and integral values are serialized as integers. Threshold checks use the reported sampled fractions and human effort; counts remain exact.
formulas.human_effort: declared practice minutes + declared support minutes per learner
formulas.human_criterion: Requested practice fits available time; human effort is within the threshold; choice is preserved; identified personal data are not requested.
formulas.overall_status: Success when all three dimensions pass; failure when none pass; partial otherwise. Missing design information is indeterminate.

limitations: All coefficients and relationships are illustrative, uncalibrated assumptions, not empirical estimates or forecasts.
The simulator reads the declared Build design. It does not verify that the candidate interface implements that design.

Workflow changes, system redesigns, and other novel mechanisms may require a new outcome model. Declaring such a design outside_scope preserves an indeterminate assessment and the stated rationale for human review; it does not award success or establish that the scope claim is correct.
Agent identity, persona, competency assignments, and ablation labels do not enter the outcome equations.
The cohort is synthetic and simplified; human learning, behavior, wellbeing, and organizational dynamics are not validated by these results.
The simulator assigns no score for including a particular competency. Any effect must pass through a changed declared design or changed conditions.
Sampled fractions depend on the recorded seed and cohort size. Conditional success is not success across the full cohort.
Reported metrics and threshold comparisons use four decimal places. This explicit quantization preserves portable replay hashes and can affect decisions extremely close to a threshold.
No real learner or human outcomes are observed. A successful simulation does not authorize deployment.
